# Turath Egypt (ورشة تراث)

> Master artisan atelier specializing in handcrafted solid brass and red copper metalwork, custom furniture, architectural lighting, and bespoke heritage fabrication in Historic Cairo.

## About Turath Egypt
Turath Egypt is a heritage metalworking workshop and design studio situated in El-Gamaliya, Historic Cairo, Egypt. Founded and led by master artisan Samy Adel (Samy Adel Abdallah), the atelier preserves centuries-old Egyptian, Mamluk, and Ottoman metalworking traditions while engineering contemporary architectural metal pieces for luxury residences, commercial spaces, and hospitality projects globally.

- **Founder & Master Artisan:** Samy Adel Abdallah
- **Location:** Bab El-Nasr, El-Gamaliya, Kahla Building, Historic Cairo, Egypt
- **Primary Website:** https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/
- **Core Crafts:** Hand-hammering, chiseling, pierced openwork (arabesque fretwork), solid brass sand casting, lost-wax bronze casting, lathed brass spinning, and custom chemical patina finishes.

## The 9 Main Collections & Categories

1. [Lighting Fixtures](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/lighting.html)
   Bespoke brass chandeliers, arabesque pendant lanterns, architectural wall sconces, and sculptural floor lamps creating warm, dynamic shadow projections.

2. [Solid Brass Mirrors](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/mirrors.html)
   Handcrafted vanity and statement wall mirrors framed in sculpted, hand-chiseled, and antiqued solid brass.

3. [Tables & Consoles](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/tables.html)
   Luxury consoles, coffee tables, dining tables, and banquettes crafted from solid brass, forged copper, and integrated marble or glass tops.

4. [Architectural Handles](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/handles.html)
   Heavy solid brass entry door pulls, bespoke cabinetry hardware, and ergonomic push plates with authentic artisan textures.

5. [Custom Handrails](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/handrails.html)
   Tailored straight and spiral staircase handrails, decorative brass balustrades, and structural architectural railings.

6. [Decorative Objects](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/decor.html)
   Hand-hammered brass vases, heritage incense burners, geometric desktop ornaments, and bespoke metal sculptures.

7. [Brass & Copper Wall Art](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/wall-art.html)
   Three-dimensional repoussé panels, oxidized patina wall installations, and hand-cut Islamic geometric bas-reliefs.

8. [Partitions & Screens](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/partitions.html)
   Freestanding room dividers, perforated brass mashrabiya lattice screens, and decorative architectural partition panels.

9. [Luxury Tableware](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/tableware.html)
   Hand-spun solid brass and copper serving trays, dining accessories, candelabras, and hammered hollowware.

## Interactive Features & Films
- [Featured Handcrafted Masterpieces](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/masterpieces.html): Highlight reel of signature commissioned artifacts.
- [Craftsmanship in Motion](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/action.html): Multi-angle workshop films documenting fire-forging, hand-hammering, and chemical patina finishing.
- [Bespoke Inquiries & Custom Commissions](https://turath-egypt.vercel.app/#bespoke): Consultation request form for interior designers, architects, and collectors.
